bio: Oriole is a haven of calm in the bustling city centre. The upscale bistro decor is alluring – the bar is terrific – though a spot on the verdant terrace is really the place to be. This is quite the hidden gem! The contemporary take on Mediterranean flavours, with a particular emphasis on vegetables, suits the setting perfectly. The Oriole Express set menu, with different options for each course, showcases the cuisine and produce of a given country every month. Whether you're tucking into grilled pimientos de Padrón, pâté en croûte or frango estufado with chicken, this Mediterranean-style feast is authentic, exquisite and inspired....
